requirement: Describe Study 20140159 as a Phase 3, multicenter, open-label, single-arm pediatric extension of parent studies 20130356 and 20110100, with 28 weeks of cinacalcet treatment and four weeks of safety follow-up.

evidence.text: Amendment 3 synopsis and schema define the pediatric extension, parent studies, treatment period, and follow-up.
SAP sections 3.1-3.1.2 restate the design and parent-study pathways.

requirement: State that up to 78 eligible participants may enter from the two parent studies and that the extension sample size is operational rather than based on formal power for a confirmatory hypothesis.

evidence.text: The protocol permits up to 78 subjects and treats enrollment as inherited from the parent studies.
SAP section 3.2 states that up to 78 subjects may enroll.

requirement: Make all endpoint analyses descriptive: do not define a confirmatory null hypothesis, multiplicity-adjusted success rule, or treatment-comparison claim for this single-arm extension.

evidence.text: Amendment 3 specifies estimates and descriptive summaries rather than formal testing.
The SAP states that there is no formal statistical testing and all analyses are descriptive.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as participant incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events of interest during Study 20140159, including protocol-defined hypocalcemia, nausea, vomiting, QTc prolongation, seizure, and infection categories.

evidence.text: The synopsis and amended primary-endpoint section identify incidence of treatment-emergent events of interest.
The SAP defines the EOI categories and primary incidence summary.

requirement: For the primary endpoint, tabulate participant incidence by EOI category and MedDRA preferred term in the Safety Analysis Set and provide two-sided 95% confidence intervals for overall incidence; for the final combined parent-plus-extension analysis, also report follow-up-time-adjusted incidence.

evidence.text: SAP section 10.5 gives incidence, confidence-interval, and follow-up-time-adjusted summaries.

requirement: Define the Full Analysis Set as every participant enrolled in Study 20140159.

evidence.text: Amendment 3 replaces the FAS definition with all enrolled Study 20140159 subjects.
SAP section 7.1 gives the same FAS definition.

requirement: Define the Safety Analysis Set as enrolled participants receiving at least one cinacalcet dose in Study 20140159, and bind primary and safety analyses to that set.

evidence.text: The governing protocol defines the treated safety set and applies it to primary and safety endpoints.
SAP sections 7.2 and 10.5 bind the primary analysis to treated subjects.

requirement: Define the Efficacy Analysis Set as enrolled participants receiving at least one Study 20140159 dose and having at least one post-Day-1 assessment, and use it for secondary efficacy endpoints unless an endpoint is explicitly restricted to the parent-study SOC subset.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the efficacy set and its use for secondary endpoints.
SAP sections 7.3 and 10.6 bind efficacy analyses to EAS or the SOC set by endpoint.

requirement: Define separate per-protocol sets for Study 20140159 alone and for the combined parent-plus-extension history, excluding important protocol deviations or endpoint-specific noncompliance and requiring at least one applicable laboratory measurement for each sensitivity analysis.

evidence.text: SAP sections 7.5 and 7.6 define the two per-protocol sets and endpoint-specific subsets.

requirement: Include the secondary binary endpoints of at least 30% iPTH reduction from the relevant baseline to mean Weeks 11/15 and Weeks 23/28, plus mean iPTH at most 300 pg/mL at Weeks 23/28, reporting proportions with 95% confidence intervals.

evidence.text: Amendment 3 adds the iPTH secondary endpoints and descriptive estimates.
The SAP specifies analysis timing, populations, and confidence intervals.

requirement: Summarize percent change in iPTH and changes in corrected total serum calcium and phosphorus from the relevant baseline to mean Weeks 23/28, and show corrected calcium and phosphorus at baseline, Week 11, and Week 28.

evidence.text: The amended secondary endpoints cover iPTH, corrected calcium, and phosphorus.
SAP section 10.6.1 gives endpoint timing and descriptive summaries.

requirement: For Weeks 11/15 binary response, classify a participant with neither scheduled iPTH value as a nonresponder; for Weeks 23/28, use the mean of the last two available postbaseline dose-titration values, one value if only one exists, and nonresponse if none exists.

evidence.text: SAP section 10.6.1 defines the endpoint-specific missing-value derivations.

requirement: For final binary-endpoint sensitivity analyses, include inverse-probability weighting, completer, per-protocol, and nearest-two-value analyses, with the IPW missingness model considering baseline iPTH, corrected calcium, phosphorus, age group, sex, race, nausea, vomiting, symptomatic hypocalcemia, and observed end-of-treatment reasons.

evidence.text: The SAP sensitivity table specifies IPW covariates and completer, PP, and nearest-two strategies.

requirement: For continuous Weeks 23/28 efficacy endpoints, provide final repeated-measures sensitivity models with parent treatment group, baseline age group, scheduled visit, and treatment-by-visit interaction, using an unstructured within-participant covariance, together with completer and per-protocol analyses.

evidence.text: The continuous-endpoint sensitivity table specifies model terms, covariance, completer, and PP analyses.

requirement: Assess the effect of a greater-than-14-day interruption between the parent-study end-of-investigational-product visit and Study 20140159 Day 1 by reporting relevant combined-study efficacy endpoints separately for participants with and without that interruption.

evidence.text: SAP section 10.6.2 specifies a dose-interruption sensitivity analysis.

requirement: Treat growth velocity and change in Tanner stage as exploratory endpoints, summarizing both from Study 20140159 baseline to end of study and from first cinacalcet dose across the combined parent-plus-extension history; analyze available paired assessments without imputing missing growth data.

evidence.text: The protocol defines extension-only and combined growth endpoints.
The SAP gives growth baselines and complete-pair/no-imputation handling.

requirement: Code adverse events with MedDRA and summarize treatment-emergent, serious, treatment-related, serious treatment-related, fatal, withdrawal-causing, and events-of-interest incidences by system organ class and preferred term, including focused hypocalcemia, seizure, and infection questionnaire events.

evidence.text: The governing protocol defines AE coding and incidence summaries.
SAP section 10.7.1 specifies MedDRA coding and AE tables.

requirement: Summarize laboratory actual values and changes over time, CTCAE grade shifts, and participant incidence below each prespecified corrected and ionized calcium threshold, preserving the less-than signs corrected in the 2016-06-01 superseding amendment.

evidence.text: The superseding amendment corrects the inequality signs in protocol Section 10.4.4.
SAP section 10.7.2 specifies grade shifts and calcium thresholds.

requirement: Limit ECG analysis to descriptive QTcB summaries and listings of abnormal ECGs or QTcB at least 500 msec, explicitly noting that routine standard-of-care ECG collection is not suitable for a formal QTc-effect assessment or cross-trial meta-analysis.

evidence.text: SAP section 10.7.4 limits interpretation of routine ECG data.

requirement: Summarize cinacalcet exposure using days treated, minimum and maximum daily dose, cumulative dose, distribution across dose levels, starting and maximum weight-adjusted dose, and participant compliance, for Study 20140159 and the combined parent-plus-extension period.

evidence.text: SAP section 10.7.5 specifies exposure and compliance summaries.

requirement: Specify conservative partial-date handling: query missing postdose AE dates and impute unresolved starts toward Study Day 1 or the earliest compatible date for treatment-emergence classification; impute concomitant-medication starts to the earliest compatible date and stops to the latest compatible date, while leaving wholly missing medication dates unimputed.
acceptable_values: do not impute wholly missing medication dates

evidence.text: SAP section 9.3.2 gives the partial-date algorithms.

requirement: Keep extension-only analyses distinct from final combined analyses across Studies 20130356, 20110100, and 20140159, and retain parent-study treatment grouping where specified instead of presenting the historical comparison as randomized treatment within the single-arm extension.

evidence.text: The amended analysis sections distinguish Study 20140159 from combined parent data.
The SAP repeatedly separates extension-only and combined summaries.

requirement: Ask the statistical team to confirm endpoint-specific sensitivity implementation, exact confidence-interval methods, analysis-cutoff conventions, and any additional regulatory interim analyses before making them binding; do not infer these operational choices solely from the protocol.

evidence.text: The protocol delegates endpoint-specific missing-data handling and additional analysis detail to the SAP.

notes: SAP-only operational choices must not become hidden protocol-only facts.
